_comment: Copy to gate_bridge.json and edit. Keys starting with _ are notes. NEVER put the device secret in this file: set the environment variable named in device_secret_env (or point device_secret_file to a file only this user can read).
_direction: ENTRY or EXIT for a one-way reader; null = the direction set on the device in GymOps (BOTH devices default to ENTRY).
_state_dir: Cached signed allowlist + offline event buffer live here. Keep it on persistent storage.
_inputs: Any of: keyboard (USB card/QR reader typing into this console), http (fingerprint terminal / vendor middleware), exit-button (USB push button that sends Enter). keyboard and exit-button both use the console, pick one.

keyboard._card_format: hex (reader types A1B2C3D4) or decimal (reader types 0002712847); GymOps stores the hex UID.

http._bind: 127.0.0.1 = only programs on this computer can call it. If the fingerprint terminal calls from the LAN, use 0.0.0.0 AND set the token variable.
http._drive_relay: true = the bridge opens the relay itself; false = only return the decision (the terminal drives its own relay).

_relay: type print (just log), command (run a program; arguments list, no shell), http (call a network relay board), none. Placeholders: {seconds} {decision} {reason} {direction}.
_deny_signal: Optional red LED / beep when access is DENIED. Same shape as relay; type none to switch off.

offline._allow_unknown_exit: Let anyone with a card out while offline (never trap people inside).

commands._forward_url: Optional: POST each enrolment / delete command (JSON) to the fingerprint vendor's middleware. null = only log them.
